using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Provides extensions methods for <see cref="ILogger"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static class LoggerExtensions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Formats and writes a log message at the Information level.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="logger">The <see cref="ILogger"/> to write to.</param>
        /// <param name="logLevel">The entry will be written on this level.</param>
        /// <param name="eventId">The event id associated with the log.</param>
        /// <param name="state">The object that will be formatted and written to the log.</param>
        /// <param name="exception">The exception related to this log, if any.</param>
        /// <param name="formatter">Function to create a <see cref="string"/> message for the given <paramref name="state"/> and <paramref name="exception"/>.</param>
        public static void Log(
            this ILogger logger,
            LogLevel logLevel,
            EventId eventId,
            object state,
            Exception exception,
            Func<object, Exception, string> formatter)
        {
            logger.Log(logLevel, eventId, state, exception, formatter);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Formats and writes a log message at the Information level.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="logger">The <see cref="ILogger"/> to write to.</param>
        /// <param name="eventId">The event id associated with the log.</param>
        /// <param name="state">The object that will be formatted and written to the log.</param>
        /// <param name="exception">The exception related to this log, if any.</param>
        /// <param name="formatter">Function to create a <see cref="string"/> message for the given <paramref name="state"/> and <paramref name="exception"/>.</param>
        public static void LogInformation(
            this ILogger logger,
            EventId eventId,
            object state,
            Exception exception,
            Func<object, Exception, string> formatter)
        {
            logger.Log(LogLevel.Information, eventId, state, exception, formatter);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Formats and writes a log message at the Information level.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="logger">The <see cref="ILogger"/> to write to.</param>
        /// <param name="eventId">The event id associated with the log.</param>
        /// <param name="state">The object that will be formatted and written to the log.</param>
        public static void LogInformation(
            this ILogger logger,
            EventId eventId,
            object state)
        {
            logger.Log(LogLevel.Information, eventId, state, null, null);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Formats and writes a log message at the Information level.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="logger">The <see cref="ILogger"/> to write to.</param>
        /// <param name="message">The log message.</param>
        /// <param name="args">Format arguments for the log message.</param>
        public static void LogInformation(this ILogger logger, string message, params object[] args)
        {
            logger.Log(LogLevel.Information, 0, (message, args), null, LogInformationMessageFormatter);
        }

        private static string LogInformationMessageFormatter(object state, Exception error)
        {
            var tuple = state as (string, object[]);
            return tuple?.Item1 ?? string.Empty;
        }
    }
}

```csharp
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Tests
{
    public class MigrateLinkedChildrenTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogInformation_CalledWithCorrectMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateLinkedChildren>>();
            var migrateLinkedChildren = new MigrateLinkedChildren(loggerMock.Object, null, null, null, null);

            // Act
            migrateLinkedChildren.CleanupItemsFromDeletedLibraries(null);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("No items from deleted libraries found."), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
```
